interpretation: Joint whole-scene template alignment underperforms both unary ordered-center and pairwise relational comparators on Fresh4.
Clause/discourse reordering is sufficient to damage whole-scene similarity even when the underlying KFS relation is preserved.
Therefore Language-level presentation order must be separable from Theater relation structure, while Music/event order remains separately causal when the modeled relation says it is.
The next learner should induce local relation-bearing clause/operator templates and compose them into an indexed graph rather than classify an entire utterance as one pattern.
